The standard MyFonts desktop licence covers installation in licensed desktop applications and creation of static, flattened images, but it does not expressly grant worldwide film, television/broadcast, or all-media rights. Motion-graphics use may be covered when the type is rendered into a non-editable image, but a separate written audiovisual/broadcast licence should be obtained for this featured, worldwide, perpetual film use.
